item.text: I’m checking Mistral’s retrieval and backend documentation to compare the query-scoping behavior of Postgres and Vespa directly.

item.query: site:docs.mistral.ai Postgres backend retrieval context Vespa ...

queries: site:docs.mistral.ai Postgres backend retrieval context Vespa

item.text:
No. While both backends share the same retrieval interfaces, their query-scoping behavior differs.

The Postgres backend accepts `IngestContext` and `RetrievalContext` but only propagates them; it does not derive tenant filters or apply `group_id`/`yql_filter`. Queries can therefore see the full collection unless you isolate tenants by collection/table or filter before querying. Vespa does apply that context-based scoping.

- [Postgres backend — context-derived filtering limitations](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/postgres)
- [Search index — backend behavior comparison](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index)
